summary: Full implementation plan to make SmartAGENT agentic: adds a ReAct reasoning loop (Thought → Action → Observation), 8 security-focused tools (read_file, scan_code, search_code, analyze_security, etc.), conversation memory with sliding window, interactive CLI chat mode, and one-shot agent command. All running locally on GTX 1650 with 4-bit quantization, no Ollama.
